title: 2026 Merida Reacto 6000 V5: the smart aero upgrade nobody’s reviewing

takeaways.text: The 2027 Reacto is the first frame update in about six years; the 6000 has electronic shifting but no power meter, and its fully integrated cockpit makes stem changes expensive.
It feels noticeably stiffer and more planted than his old bike yet not harsh, helped by 30 mm tires at about 70 psi; it catches crosswinds a little with the deep wheels.

disclosure: Owner video; he bought the bike himself and no sponsorship is stated.
summary: An owner's first impressions of the fifth-generation Merida Reacto 6000 (CF3 frame) coming from a rim-brake bike.
